name: indigen-world
description: Monorepo for the Indigen World cultural-technology ecosystem.

scripts.typecheck: npm run build:web-ui && npm run --workspaces --if-present typecheck
scripts.test: npm run test:contracts && npm run test:function-helpers && npm run test:rules && npm run test:storage-rules && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --project demo-indigen-world --only firestore "node --test firebase/tests/firestore.rules.test.mjs firebase/tests/creator.rules.test.mjs firebase/tests/community.rules.test.mjs firebase/tests/reelsAndChats.rules.test.mjs firebase/tests/learningAndShop.rules.test.mjs firebase/tests/ads.rules.test.mjs"
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build:functions && cross-env FUNCTIONS_DISCOVERY_TIMEOUT=120 firebase emulators:exec --project demo-indigen-world --only auth,firestore,functions "node --test firebase/tests/decideReview.test.mjs firebase/tests/creatorFunctions.test.mjs firebase/tests/publicForms.test.mjs"
